name: Rating
description: A star rating input component. Supports interactive selection and read-only display with half-star precision. Uses clickable star icons with keyboard navigation.

notes: Uses role='radiogroup' on the wrapper with individual stars as radio options.
Arrow keys navigate between stars; Enter/Space selects the focused star.
In readOnly mode, the component uses aria-readonly and is not focusable.
aria-valuenow reflects the current numeric rating value.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).

onChange.description: Callback fired when a star is clicked.

count.description: Total number of stars to display.

readOnly.description: When true, displays the rating without interaction. Supports half-star display.

size.description: Controls the size of each star icon.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Always provide an accessible label via aria-label on the Rating component.
Use readOnly mode for displaying aggregate ratings or user-submitted ratings.
Use the count prop to customise the scale (e.g. count=10 for a 1-10 scale).
dont: Do not use for binary like/dislike — use Toggle or a button pair instead.
Do not omit aria-label — screen readers need context for the rating purpose.
